description: Building the fish farm management system for GreenFeed as an outsourced project, including its warehouse integration, with Claude Code at the center of the development workflow.

Built the Sales module of FMS, the system that runs GreenFeed’s 32 pig farms (14-person team, 3 on Sales): pig selection and weighing, orders, weight-based pricing and payments, real-time sync with inventory and pig status, and issuing e-invoices, with the final transactions sent on to SAP. Background workers sync orders from Odoo to Solomon and process 1,000–2,000 transactions a day.
Building e-commerce sites and Telegram bots for individual clients, end to end: backend, frontend, and deployment on a VPS with Docker.

Built APIs for the internal lending portal and service gateway across the whole loan lifecycle (applications, appraisal, approval, and disbursement), integrating banking systems, MoMo, and partner APIs for money transfers.

Built the system branches nationwide use for telecom contract transactions (new contracts, address and plan changes), working across backend and frontend, then helped rebuild it as microservices on .NET 6, Kafka, and Redis in a 5-person team. Every query had to finish within the DBA team’s 20-second timeout on telecom-scale data, so I tuned complex SQL Server queries and moved business rules into stored procedures that could change without a rebuild. Also wrote shared libraries for logging, caching, and data access, and hardened the APIs against SQL injection and request flooding.

Maintained the company’s ERP and outsourced projects, and built a scheduled service that collected bank and lottery data every day, with Redis caching, centralized logging on Elasticsearch and Kibana, and Telegram and email alerts for results and errors.
